'''R5-D8''' was an [[R5-series astromech droid]] used by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] pilot [[Jek Tono Porkins/Legends|Jek Tono Porkins]]. The R5 unit assisted in navigation, in-flight maintenance, and repairs. Porkins had used the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] since he was a part of the [[Tierfon Yellow Aces/Legends|Tierfon Yellow Aces]].<ref name="Power">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Power of the Jedi|pack=Jek Porkins (X-Wing Pilot)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/potjporkins.asp}}</ref> R5-D8 exploded together with Porkins's [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|assault]] on the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="Episode IV" />

==Behind the scenes==
R5-D8 first appeared as a prop in the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="Episode IV" /> It was first named in [[2000]] in a "Force File" included with a Jek Porkins action figure released by [[Hasbro]] as part of the ''[[Star Wars: Power of the Jedi]]'' line.

On [[July]] [[July 13|13]], [[2012]], R5-D8 appeared as an action figure in a [[Toys "R" Us]]&ndash;exclusive ''Yavin Pilot Pack'' released by [[Hasbro]], and appeared in a [[LEGO Star Wars|LEGO ''Star Wars'']] set that same year.
